summary: More than most people, an appetite for more and a need to believe in something and a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you reach, grow, and lift the room and you build things that last and carry real weight. At the edge, you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver.

gift: At your best: you reach, grow, and lift the room, and you build things that last and carry real weight.
shadow: The trap: you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver — or you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes.
